newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Suncorp-Metway sets up EMTN programme.
newsitem.headline: Suncorp-Metway sets up EMTN programme.

text.p: Insurance and banking group Suncorp-Metway Ltd said on Thursday it is establishing a Euro Medium Term Note programme through arranger Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
The size of the programme is yet to be finalised, but Deutsche Morgan Grenfell will act a lead manager when the borrower launches its first benchmark issue later this year.
Suncorp-Metway said the programme will form part of its overall global funding strategies, providing diversity and pricing alternatives on its wholesale borrowings.
